summary: A Depth subscription whose first frame is a quote (no book yet), then a five-level quote2 book, a thinner book with numeric zero totals, and a cleared book.

notes: The web publishes to Depth subscribers only on quote2 frames (samco_adapter.py _on_data: target_modes [3] for subscription_mode 3, [1, 2] otherwise).
The thin book sends tbq/taq as the numbers 0: real zero totals (web _first_present, openalgo#2397).

deviations.reason: The desktop sends a Depth client a frame for Samco's first quote frame, before any quote2 book, with five invented zero levels a side; the web publishes to Depth subscribers only on quote2 frames, so its first Depth frame carries a real book.
deviations.ref: audit WEBSOCKET_AUDIT_REMAINING_BROKERS.md, samco row (all-zero book on quote before the first quote2); streaming.rs book()

deviations.reason: The web sends Samco's ch and chPer as change and change_percentage for every instrument; the desktop sends a change for indices only (common carrier, audit C04).
The web sends Samco's ch and chPer as change and change_percentage for every instrument; the desktop sends a change for indices only (common carrier, audit C04).

The desktop pads each side to five levels: a three-level bid and two-level ask show as five with zero levels, and a cleared book as five zero levels a side, levels Samco never sent; the web sends the levels Samco sent and leaves depth out when both sides are empty.
deviations.ref: streaming.rs book() (resize to 5); samcoWebSocket.py _normalize_market_data (depth only when a side has levels)

deviations.reason: The desktop sends Samco's web name for last_quantity (last_trade_quantity, which the web's Quote frames carry) in Depth frames too, beside last_quantity; the web's Depth frames carry last_quantity only.
deviations.ref: feed::dialect (WS-05): aliases in Quote and Depth alike

deviations.reason: data.mode is the label every broker's frames carry on the desktop (ltp, quote, full), as the recorded Zerodha transcripts carry it; this web adapter puts its subscription mode number there.

Samco streams OI (oI) on its quote stream and the web's client reads it as open_interest, but the adapter's normaliser forwards it in no mode, so a Depth client of a derivative never sees OI; the desktop sends it.
